A [[Yresilini]] was trained as a '''general''' by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] student [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]]<ref name="CC" /> at some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Tann had been challenged by a [[Unidentified professor (Chiss Academy)|professor]] at the [[Chiss Academy]] to train a group of Yresilini into an [[Army/Legends|army]], overcoming the [[Species/Legends|species']] perceived untrainable nature. Tann began by appointing one Yresilini as a [[General/Legends|general]] and giving him several rudimentary commands, which the general and his fellow creatures laughed at. Tann had the general [[Death/Legends|executed]] in front of the other Yresilini, and then chose a [[Unidentified second Yresilini general|successor]] who obeyed her instructions implicitly and led the other Yresilini to do likewise.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yresilini general was mentioned in Sev'rance Tann's databank entry in the [[2002]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.<ref name="CC" />
